_comment: Local configuration for the Godot AI tunnel plugin and tunnel_manager.ps1. Copy this file to tunnel_config.json before use. tunnel_config.json is git-ignored and should not be committed because executable_path is machine-specific.
_instructions: 1. Copy tunnel_config.example.json to tunnel_config.json in this same folder.
2. Set executable_path to the full path of tunnel-client.exe on this machine.
3. Keep profile and health_listen_addr aligned with your tunnel-client profile unless you intentionally changed them.
4. Set enabled to false to prevent the Godot editor plugin from starting or adopting the tunnel automatically.
5. tunnel_manager.ps1 and plugin.gd both require tunnel_config.json and will stop with an error if it is missing or invalid.
